videos.prompt: Q版鲸鱼女仆少女像被一股看不见的力量提着后衣领，轻轻飘离地面，在半空中晃腿。0–1秒：身体向上浮起一点点（双脚离开原来的位置约半个脚掌高），吓了一跳，眼睛瞪圆，双手缩到胸前。1–4秒：悬在半空，身体像钟摆一样小幅左右晃荡，双腿在空中乱蹬，双手握拳轻轻挥动，表情慌张又委屈，嘴巴张开，长发、裙摆和小鲸尾跟着晃。4–5秒：慢慢落回地面，双脚站稳，拍拍裙子，回到第一帧的站姿和平静表情。画面固定机位，镜头完全不动，不推拉、不摇移，始终是能看到全身的远景，绝不出现特写或半身镜头。背景从头到尾都是均匀的纯绿色（#00FF00），颜色和亮度不变，没有地面、阴影、反光、文字或水印。画面里只有她一个人：不出现任何人的手、手臂、绳子或其他物体。人物始终是参考图里的同一个人类少女：脸、发型、发色、女仆装、头饰、耳边的鲸鳍和身后那条细小的鲸尾都保持原样，鲸尾大小不变；她不会变成鲸鱼或其他动物。人物始终完整地待在画面中央，大小不变。最后一帧与第一帧的姿势完全相同。
videos.review: 未采用：“看不见的力量”被画成聚光灯光柱和地面光圈，背景不再均匀。

input_images.role: 唯一输入图，用于保留脸、眼型、描边、比例和配色。负责人确认是自己用 AI 生成的原画。

preparation: Pillow 12.3.0。按 G−max(R,B)<130 定位角色，≥190 的原画背景归一为纯绿，低于该阈值的混色边缘保留。将前景外接框等比缩至高 703 px，以两鞋中间对齐画布中线；Lanczos 缩放后将色差 ≥215 的像素归一为纯绿。缩略图用 Lanczos 直接缩放整个定稿画面。坐标原点为左上，边界框右、下端不包含在内。

candidates.prompt:
Edit the attached character illustration. Use this image as the actual model sheet. Keep the exact identity and the deliberately simple, hand-inked chibi drawing. Redraw only what is necessary to turn this raised-arm, floating pose into a neutral, straight-on standing animation anchor. Preserve the original very wide, huge head, low wide baby face with a tiny point mouth and a faint blush, tiny compact body and stubby legs. Keep the exact eye shape, spacing and gaze: heavy black upper lash, rounded blue eyes, dark vertical pupils, large sky-blue lower iris bands and small white catchlights. Keep center pointed fringe between the eyes, broad low outer bangs, navy periwinkle hair with a few broad blue highlight shapes, single curved ahoge, horizontal whale fins with white undersides and blue bows, simple thick dark-navy contour with slightly thinner interior strokes. Preserve the reference's navy maid dress, scalloped white headband, white apron with flat blue whale emblem, chest ribbon with tiny blue gem, gold bows at skirt hem, white stockings and glossy Mary Janes. No detailed strand rendering; keep the clean flat color blocks and soft cel shading of the input. Shoulders and hips square to camera, chin level, eyes looking directly at viewer, both arms lowered naturally along sides, two hands visible, both feet resting at same level. Keep the single forked whale tail on viewer's RIGHT behind her dress and broad flowing hair on viewer's left. Produce ONE full-body character in a horizontal 16:9 canvas. Head and feet centered on a vertical axis. Uppermost tip of her ahoge at 20% of the entire frame and bottom edges of shoes at 85%. Leave generous uninterrupted negative space left and right. Edge-to-edge single exact solid chroma green RGB(0,255,0) #00FF00. No scene, floor, reflection, contact shadow, gradients, green rim light, labels, text, framing, or other graphic.
A: Trace the character's facial design and broad fluffy silhouette particularly closely. A poised neutral stance with wrists just alongside the skirt, feet slightly apart; tail flukes peek out at lower right. Keep the tiny surprised dot mouth.
candidates.visual_difference: 圆点嘴，双鞋平行微分，左侧后发展开最宽，右侧尾鳍贴着裙摆。

candidates.prompt:
Edit the single supplied model sheet of the whale maid into ONE full-body side-view walk-ready animation keyframe. Redraw her as if the camera has moved around to her side. Anatomical near-profile: her head, visible eye, nose, chin, chest, knees and both shoe toes all point to the viewer's RIGHT edge. Her nose and lips interrupt the rightmost facial silhouette; exactly ONE full eye is visible, no far eye. Near shoulder hides the far shoulder. She is standing still at double support before a small step: two distinguishable navy Mary Janes pointing right at staggered x positions, both flat soles resting on the SAME invisible horizontal line. Arms hanging relaxed, fingers by the skirt. Keep the master's actual big round head to compact body ratio, cheek and gentle blue eye with pale lower iris, single arched ahoge, indigo-violet long hair fading blue at the tips, white ruffled cap, horizontal navy ear fin with white underside and tiny blue bow, brooch, navy puffed sleeve maid dress with gold hem embroidery, white ruffled apron and its existing small printed blue spouting-whale emblem, white socks, shoes. Foreshorten the apron emblem naturally; do not turn her torso toward camera to display it. Long hair falls DOWN her back to the LEFT of her body. Exactly ONE slender attached whale tail projects from back of waist to SCREEN LEFT, separately readable from the hair, ending in the same small bifurcated navy-and-cream fluke. No whale body, facial features on tail, second animal or tail on the right. Preserve the fine outlines, nuanced colored shading and palette of the supplied painting. Wide landscape 16:9 uniform opaque pure chroma green (#00FF00) edge-to-edge. Center the stance, top of ahoge near y=20%, soles near y=85%, both shoes and entire fluke within frame. No ground line, shadows, letters, watermark, labels, gradients, props, borders or other views.
